perturbation-chain.alt: A chain of boxes tracing a poison through a mitochondrion. Cyanide blocks the last electron carrier, so electrons cannot pass to oxygen; the chain stops pumping protons; the proton gradient runs down; ATP synthase makes little ATP; the measurable prediction is that oxygen use falls and ATP falls. A side branch shows NADH building up, so the cell relies on glycolysis and fermentation, and lactate rises.
